comment: My sibling ate the leftovers with my name on them, then asked why I looked upset.
My coworker said the meeting could have been an email, then scheduled a follow-up meeting about it.
They replied 'k' to the six-paragraph message I spent an hour writing.
My manager said production was completely fine while every dashboard was flashing red.
My friend borrowed my charger for one minute and returned it three weeks later.
My roommate turned the thermostat down again, then wore a jacket and complained that our apartment was cold.
I finished the entire group project, and my teammate asked whether we had remembered to add their name.
My partner put one spoon in the dishwasher and told me they had cleaned the kitchen.
